thought.text: The patcher works for all stage patterns. Launching wave 2 (26 services) in the background with PAR=2 to avoid overloading the flaky transport:

Wait — tex2pdf's test-deps stage: `uv sync --frozen --dev` — this installs the workspace project and all dependencies into .venv, and then runs `uv pip install -e src/core -e src/api`. With the full COPY added after WORKDIR, this should work.

Hmm, but wait — tex2pdf's test-deps stage: `uv sync --frozen --dev` — with the full COPY added after WORKDIR, this should work.

Alright, let's launch wave 2 in the background with PAR=2. Note: the frontend is still building (sub-MFE not yet; main frontend build finished at 18:40 — actually, the tail showed "✓ built in 18m 40s" which is one of the parallel vite builds; the Dockerfile has a `wait` after all the parallel builds, and then the final stage copies... the build is not finished. The frontend build is still running as PID 18284.

Also, the transport is unstable. To avoid overload, wave 2 will be run at PAR=2. The frontend build is heavy on memory (about 4GB). The 2 backend builds will add further load. It's risky, but let's proceed; the builds are incremental and resumable via the cache.
